children: Sun Communities entered into a partnership agreement amendment to create Series M Preferred Units in its operating partnership. The units carry quarterly distributions of 3.2% through Oct. 1, 2027, 3.4% through Oct. 1, 2028, and 3.6% thereafter, and are exchangeable into common stock based on a $174.00 conversion price. Holders may require redemption at $100 per unit plus accrued distributions on or after Oct. 1, 2027. On Oct. 1, 2026, SCOLP issued 283,126 Series M Preferred Units at $100 each ($28.3 million) as consideration for contributed assets.
